title: Seat Gap Check
summary: Catches group seat picks that split the party, leave a single empty seat or seat a child away from every adult.
description: Seat-map check for group bookings: a party split across the row, a single empty seat left behind (which many venues refuse) and a child seated away from every adult, with problem seats marked and a one-tap move to the nearest block that fits.
catches: Party split across a row or aisle
A single orphan seat left between taken seats (orphanRule)
A child with no adult beside them
One-tap move to the nearest contiguous block, children beside adults
limits: Venue rules differ; set orphanRule to match yours
Works on the seat map you pass; prices and accessibility seats are not considered
a11y: Seat map is a role=grid with rowheaders; one tab stop with arrow-key, Home and End navigation
Each seat button has an aria-label with its status and aria-pressed when chosen
Issue icons are aria-hidden with text alongside
stops: Group split across row at booking
